description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$p/.vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$p/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" PostToolUse --agent claude; exit 0

p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$p/.vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$p/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" Stop --agent claude; exit 0

p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$p/.vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$p/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Node is missing from PATH, so the Workflow Kit hooks (kit check, Ponytail, Impeccable) do not run. Install Node (the version in .node-version) and restart the session."}'; exit 0; }; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then k="$WORKFLOW_KIT_DIR"; [ -n "$k" ] || { c="$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" && k="$(dirname "$(dirname "$c")")/workflow-kit"; }; [ -z "$k" ] || [ -f "$k/scripts/kit-hook.mjs" ] || GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null clone --quiet https://github.com/snagg-app/workflow-kit.git "$k" >/dev/null 2>&1; f="$k/scripts/kit-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"The shared Workflow Kit checkout is missing and could not be cloned (offline?). Clone https://github.com/snagg-app/workflow-kit.git to a folder named workflow-kit next to the project, or set WORKFLOW_KIT_DIR."}'; exit 0; }; fi; exec node "$f" SessionStart --agent claude
